name: a prop placed or erased in the editor appears and goes, and dragging a brush beside it leaves it alone

steps.note: props are drawn by editor::props::PropWindow from the map, and it only redraws when told the map changed
two world sprites before anything is placed: the cursor frame and the ghost
placing one draws it, which is PropWindow::touch doing its job
a plain brush held beside it paints one tile. It also borrows the map mutably every frame it is held,
which used to respawn every prop on screen every frame; that is not countable from here, and 181 spawns
in 1.5s against 1 was measured by hand. What this does hold is that the drag ends with the prop still drawn
erasing it takes the sprite away again, by the same route

steps.shot: the computer erased, the floor tile left
